text: Doolugol alaa e naatugol ka diina; tawde ko diina goona ɓaŋnguka. Doolindiro alaa fii naatugol e makka. Peewal ngal senndondirii e majjere nden: Kala yedduɗo ɗin deweteeɗi tanaa Allaahu On o reŋtii e majji, o gomɗini Alla Tan; haray o jogitike fiɓnde hoolaare nde ka diina, nden taƴataa haa ñalnde darngal. Alla Ko Nanoowo yeewtereeji jeyaaɓe Makko, Annduɗo golleeji maɓɓe; O Yoɓitoyay ɓe ɗum.
